description: This file defines the Controller class `Filter` within the Opencart admin module. It handles tasks related to catalog filtering and country data processing, including generating country lists, country information, and cleaning up generated JSON files. The class provides methods for initiating tasks, generating JSON data files, and managing related catalog data.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing catalog filters, country data processing, and JSON data generation within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes catalog article tasks and sets up country listing tasks for each store and language.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON list of countries for a specific store and language, saving it to the filesystem.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed information for a specific country, including zones and geo zones, and saves it as a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated country JSON files from the filesystem for all store-language combinations.
